title: Real-world range and physical button complaints
summary: This topic combines several loosely related complaints around real-world range, preference for physical buttons, and a few other isolated usability remarks, with many examples lacking clear sentiment labels.

positive.summary: Positive feedback praises the balance between physical buttons and software controls.

negative.summary: Negative feedback highlights practical usability problems such as limited cargo fit for longer trips and a vague complaint framed as the driver being the main issue.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined examples mention short real-world range, especially in cold conditions, preference for real buttons, warranty dissatisfaction, and a nonspecific expression of disappointment without enough context for a firm sentiment label.

limitations: The cluster mixes unrelated subjects including range, physical controls, cargo space, warranty concerns, and a vague driver-related remark.
Most examples are labeled undetermined, which limits confidence in a sharper sentiment summary.
Some fragments are too brief or lack context to determine the underlying issue precisely.
